description: Comic-style lines written for this project (no third-party text), as the OCR reads them (capitals), with reference translations.

segments: THE TRAIN WAS DELAYED, I SWEAR!
SORRY, I DIDN'T SEE YOU THERE.
YEAH, RIGHT. YOU OWE ME A COFFEE.
DEAL. BUT YOU'RE PAYING FOR THE DONUTS.
references: Tá, sei. Você me deve um café.
Fechado. Mas você paga as rosquinhas.

segments: ARE YOU OUT OF YOUR MIND?!
references: Não por muito tempo. Me dá cobertura!

segments: IT'S A PIECE OF CAKE, YOU'LL SEE.
WHAT BRINGS YOU BACK TO TOWN?
THEN I GUESS WE'RE RIVALS NOW.
references: O que te traz de volta à cidade?
Então acho que agora somos rivais.

segments: I'M NOT HUNGRY... OKAY, MAYBE A LITTLE.
references: Enquanto isso, do outro lado da cidade...
Não tô com fome... Tá, talvez um pouco.
